name: straddle_proxy_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: A synthetic straddle can be approximated in equity markets by entering a position at a key support/resistance level and placing symmetric stop-and-reverse orders. When a stock consolidates at a well-defined level (prior day's close, VWAP, round number), going long with a tight stop that flips to short (and vice versa) mimics a straddle payoff: profit from large directional moves, small loss on whipsaws. The key insight is timing: enter when ATR contraction signals an imminent directional move (compression before expansion). Unlike option straddles, this equity proxy has no time decay but faces whipsaw risk. The edge exists when entry timing aligns with vol compression and the breakout generates a move > 2x the stop distance.
universe: NIFTY 50 constituents on NSE (top 10 by liquidity)
stock_filter: daily avg volume > ₹300cr; price near a defined pivot level (within 0.1%)
session: 10:00-15:10 IST (wait for pivot level to establish)
indicators: pivot_distance = abs(close - pivot) / pivot * 10000  # bps from pivot

conditions: ATR_compression was True within last 10 bars (recent compression)
pivot_distance was < 5 bps within last 15 bars (price was at pivot recently)
long.confirmation: close above upper_trigger with volume > 1.2x SMA(volume, 20)

conditions: ATR_compression was True within last 10 bars
pivot_distance was < 5 bps within last 15 bars
short.confirmation: close below lower_trigger with volume > 1.2x SMA(volume, 20)

entry.entry_price: market order at trigger cross; set stop-and-reverse at opposite trigger

exit.target: 2.5 * stop_distance from pivot in breakout direction (risk-reward 2.5:1)
exit.stop_loss: stop-and-reverse at opposite trigger (e.g., long stopped at lower_trigger, reverse to short)
exit.trailing_stop: after 1.5 * stop_distance gain, trail at 1.0 * stop_distance from best
exit.time_stop: exit if held > 60 mins without hitting 50% of target
exit.signal_exit: max 2 reversals per setup (3rd trigger = flat, no more attempts)

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX between 12 and 22 (need some vol but not extreme)
filters.time_filter: 10:00-14:00 IST (pivot level needs time to establish; avoid close volatility)
filters.event_filter: skip if stock has major news or earnings today (not a pure vol play)
other_filters: limit to 2 reversals per setup; if whipsawed twice, stop (choppy day)

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — the equity straddle proxy is uncommon; most traders trade directionally

weaknesses: Low win rate (42%) makes this psychologically difficult; multiple consecutive whipsaw losses are common before a large directional win
Unlike true option straddles, the equity proxy has unlimited downside if the stop-and-reverse mechanism fails (gap through stop level)
The max-2-reversals rule means the strategy exits flat on genuinely choppy days, missing the eventual breakout if it occurs after the 3rd trigger
prior_art: Natenberg (1994) on synthetic straddles; adapted for equity markets. Katz & McCormick (2000) on stop-and-reverse systems.
notes: Edge math: 0.42 * 65bps - 0.58 * 18bps = 27.3 - 10.44 = 16.86bps gross per attempt. Including reversals (avg 1.5 attempts per setup), net edge ~16.86 / 1.5 = 11.24bps. Costs ~9bps * 1.5 = 13.5bps RT. Net slightly negative per attempt but large winners (65bps+) compensate. The 22bps daily estimate assumes 2 setups with 1 winner.
